slides.title:

can disappear.
slides.body: Creators can delete or hide posts, and your save goes too.

slides.bridge: Keep what you wanted to remember, before that happens.

written down.
slides.bridge: Once the note is made, it lives in your Skwirl library.

you remember.

It keeps the note.
Not the video.
slides.body: Share the reel while it's still up, and let Skwirl finish the note.
slides.card:
A useful note you can search later.
No promise to recover a reel that's already gone.
slides.bridge: That is the part worth saving.
